'''Endor Draft''' is a booster draft format in which each player drafts from six [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] packs and builds a 40-card deck. [[Decipher]] published it in the June 1999 [[Endor Rulesheet|Endor Rules Supplement]] as "an exciting new tournament format" that "can be run as a Decipher sanctioned sealed deck tournament". The [[Players Committee]]'s ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015) reprints the rules.<ref name="endorrules">[http://www1.decipher.com/starwars/rules/endorrules.html Star Wars CCG – Endor Rules Supplement], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990915001027/http://www1.decipher.com/starwars/rules/endorrules.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="endorrules-pdf">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/endorrules.pdf Endor Rules Supplement] (endorrules.pdf), Decipher (June 1999), "Endor Draft Tournament Rules". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/endorrules.pdf Internet Archive]. Transcription: [[Endor Rulesheet]].</ref><ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195355/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' booster draft
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (1999); reprinted by the Players Committee (2015)
* '''Card pool:''' six unopened Endor packs per player; 40-card decks
* '''In use:''' 1999 &ndash; listed in 2015
* '''Also called:''' Endor Draft Tournament (Decipher)<ref name="endorrules-pdf" />
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Decipher's rules, reprinted unchanged in the Players Committee guide:<ref name="endorrules" /><ref name="endorrules-pdf" /><ref name="afg" />
* "The standalone nature of the Endor expansion allows players to take part in an exciting new tournament format." It needs a sanctioned tournament director and at least 8 players.
* "An Endor Draft tournament is run using standard Decipher sealed deck rules, but with one major difference: instead of trading cards with one opponent as in standard sealed deck tournaments, players choose cards from a much larger pool when constructing their 40-card decks."
* An even number of players is preferred; otherwise the tournament director drafts in place of a player but does not play. Each player (and the director, if drafting) provides 6 unopened Endor packs. Sides are assigned at random with equal numbers of Light and Dark.
* Players sit in groups of 6 where possible, otherwise 4 (never more than two groups of 4), with Light and Dark players alternating around the table.
* Each player opens a pack and has 45 seconds to pick the first card, then 30 seconds for each later pick. A player takes a card of their own side, except that "a foil card may be selected regardless of allegiance." A player passed a pack with no card of their side passes it on without picking.
* Packs pass right in the first round, left in the second, alternating until all six packs are drafted.
* "After all of the players have completed the draft, the tournament reverts to the standard Decipher sealed deck format, with two exceptions": deck building lasts 15 minutes, and a player with fewer than 40 cards of their side plays with as close to 40 as possible. Results are submitted by the standard sealed deck method.

== History ==
Decipher's Endor Rules Supplement page with these rules was online by September 1999.<ref name="endorrules" />

In 2000 Decipher's [[Death Star II Booster Draft]] drafted 3 Endor and 3 Death Star II boosters instead.<ref name="ds2ce-rules">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/deathstar2/rules.html Death Star II Closed Environment Tournaments Rules], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011004150405/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/tournaments/deathstar2/rules.html Internet Archive].</ref> [[DecipherCon 2002]] scheduled a "Death Star II/Endor Draft" sealed event on 1 November 2002.<ref name="dc02-sched">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventschedule-otherccg.html Event schedule: Star Wars, Young Jedi, Jedi Knights], DecipherCon 2002, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021023190505/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventschedule-otherccg.html Internet Archive].</ref>

The Players Committee guide of 2015 prints the Endor Draft rules under the heading "from Decipher's Rules Supplement for the Endor Expansion" and lists the Death Star II Booster Draft, with three Endor and three Death Star II packs, among its own formats.<ref name="afg" />
